'''SalaciousCrumb Set Your Course For Alderaan SalaciousCrumbStyle''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[SalaciousCrumb]]
* '''Published:''' 16 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 SYCFA SalaciousCrumb DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Kill everything!!!

The published list has 63 cards.
